summary: The draft discovery brief has addressed all previous objections. Citations to excluded interview P06 have been removed from citation brackets, double quotation marks around invented ad copy phrases have been stripped, invented numbers and percentages have been replaced with valid participant counts and sourced pricing tiers (€3.50 and €4.99), the dinner decision friction theme now includes side-by-side raw and evidence-weighted counts, and all experiment headers carry appropriate source citations. The brief strictly adheres to evidence guidelines and exploratory data analysis rules, with zero automated check failures.
